speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I'm Dr. Agent. You've presented with weakness and decreased sensation in your right arm; to help me understand the cause, are you experiencing any neck pain, or does the numbness follow a specific pattern like the thumb, index, or middle finger?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Brachial Plexopathy (suspected malignant infiltration or severe compression).
